commonNameZh: 志留纪齿旋软骨鱼干群
overview: Qianodus duplicis is a late Aeronian stem chondrichthyan known from 23 isolated tooth whorls, including IVPP V26641. The fossils preserve dentition and histology at about 439 Ma, but no associated jaw or articulated body.
overviewZh: Qianodus duplicis 是约 4.39 亿年前、阿伦期晚期的软骨鱼干群成员，目前依据 23 个彼此分离的牙轮记录，其中包括 IVPP V26641。牙轮是牙齿呈轮状排列的化石结构；这些材料保留了牙齿形态和组织学特征，却没有与之相连的颌骨或关节连接的身体。

ecology.diet: The tooth whorls do not preserve a feeding event, so diet is undetermined.
ecology.habitat: The Rongxi Formation records the depositional setting; the animal’s living habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: The isolated tooth whorls provide no evidence of locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: Body size cannot be estimated from isolated tooth whorls.

traits: Teeth were retained rather than shed
New teeth were added in offset lingual rows
The material is preserved as isolated tooth whorls
evidenceSummary: IVPP V26641 and the referred whorls directly preserve tooth form and histology at roughly 439 Ma. No associated body anatomy establishes its full jaw structure, crown-group membership or global range.
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V26641 和归入的牙轮在约 4.39 亿年前保存的牙齿形态与组织学特征有直接记录。由于没有相连的身体解剖，完整颌部结构、冠群归属和全球分布都不能由这些材料确定。

title.en: What can a tooth whorl reveal?
title.zh: 牙轮齿能揭示什么？

text.en: Qianodus duplicis is a late Aeronian stem chondrichthyan known from 23 isolated tooth whorls, including IVPP V26641. The fossils preserve dentition and histology at about 439 Ma, but no associated jaw or articulated body.
text.zh: Qianodus duplicis 是约 4.39 亿年前、阿伦期晚期的软骨鱼干群成员，目前依据 23 个彼此分离的牙轮记录，其中包括 IVPP V26641。牙轮是牙齿呈轮状排列的化石结构；这些材料保留了牙齿形态和组织学特征，却没有与之相连的颌骨或关节连接的身体。

title.en: New teeth in offset lingual rows
title.zh: 舌侧错列的新牙

text.en: The whorls preserve teeth that were retained rather than shed, with new teeth added in offset rows on the lingual side. Histology was examined in named material including IVPP V26641, so the study traces tooth development without a complete jaw or body.
text.zh: 这些牙轮保存了未脱落的牙齿，新的牙齿从舌侧以错列的行添加。组织学检查了包括 IVPP V26641 在内的具名材料，因此研究追踪了牙齿发育，但没有完整的颌骨或身体。

title.en: The oldest gnathostome teeth
title.zh: The oldest gnathostome teeth

scope.en: Andreev et al. (2022), pp. 964?968, especially 965?967, Figures 1?2 and Extended Data Figures 1?3: named tooth whorls, tooth addition, histology and the Rongxi Formation sample.

readerLimitations.en: The 23 isolated whorls come from the late Aeronian Rongxi Formation at Leijiatun. This records a depositional sample, not a known living habitat; the material does not establish a feeding event, locomotion, body size or ecological role.
readerLimitations.zh: 这 23 个分离的牙轮来自 Leijiatun 晚 Aeronian 阶段的 Rongxi 组。它记录的是沉积样本，而非已知的生活环境；这些材料不能确定取食事件、运动方式、身体大小或生态角色。

traitsZh: 牙齿会保留，而非脱落更替。
新牙沿着舌侧错列成行地添加。
材料以孤立的螺旋齿列形式保存。

overview: The nearly complete holotype IVPP V300000 combines a scale-covered body and a chondrichthyan-like rear branchial region with large plates of thoracic armour. That unusual character mix makes its evolutionary placement an open question.

ecology.habitat: Huixingshao Formation depositional setting; life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic body form preserved; performance not measured

evidenceSummary: One holotype provides an unusually detailed body plan, but it cannot show the species’ population variation. Its exact position among early jawed vertebrates and its ecology remain uncertain.

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: The nearly complete holotype IVPP V300000 combines a scale-covered body and a chondrichthyan-like rear branchial region with large plates of thoracic armour. That unusual character mix makes its evolutionary placement an open question.
text.zh: 近乎完整的正模 IVPP V300000 同时保存覆有细小鳞片的身体、类似软骨鱼的后部鳃区和大型胸甲。这种少见的性状组合使其演化位置仍有待检验。

title.en: A character mix in one holotype
title.zh: 一件正模中的性状组合

text.en: The described specimen has minute scales across its body and large armour plates over its thorax. Its posterior branchial region—the rear of the gill region—has chondrichthyan-like features.
text.zh:
身体覆有细小鳞片。

后部鳃区具有软骨鱼类样特征。

胸部有大型甲板。

title.en: What one holotype can and cannot show
title.zh: 一件正模能显示什么、不能显示什么

text.en: The Huixingshao Formation provides depositional context, not a resolved habitat preference. Its preserved aquatic body form does not measure locomotion, and a small, nearly complete holotype cannot define population-wide body size, diet or ecological role.
text.zh: 惠兴绍组提供沉积环境背景，但没有确定动物生前的栖地偏好。保存的水生体形并非运动能力测量；一件体型较小且近乎完整的正模，也不能确定全种体型、食性或生态角色。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: One holotype provides an unusually detailed body plan, but it cannot show the species’ population variation. Its exact position among early jawed vertebrates and its ecology remain uncertain.
text.zh: 一件正模提供了细节丰富的身体构型，但不能显示种群内变异。它在早期有颌脊椎动物中的确切位置及生态仍不确定。

title.en: The oldest complete jawed vertebrates from the early Silurian of China
title.zh: The oldest complete jawed vertebrates from the early Silurian of China

scope.en: The study describes articulated early jawed-vertebrate material; Shenacanthus is represented by one holotype.
scope.zh: 研究描述重庆地区关节相连的早期有颌脊椎动物材料；Shenacanthus 仅有一件正模。

commonNameZh: 泥盆纪镶嵌型软骨鱼干群
overview: The only known specimen, UMZC 2000.32, preserves several skull and body systems in one compressed slab. Its mixed anatomy supports a stem-chondrichthyan placement in the cited analysis, while the missing tail and single-individual sample limit broader conclusions.

ecology.habitat: The fossil comes from the Lower Plattenkalk depositional setting; its living habitat is unresolved.
ecology.locomotion: It was an aquatic fish, but this specimen does not measure swimming performance.
ecology.bodySize: One compressed specimen preserves an incomplete body outline, so total size is not established here.
ecology.locomotionZh: 它是一种水生鱼类，但这件标本不能测量其游泳表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 一件压扁标本保存的身体轮廓不完整，因此这里无法确定整体大小。

traits: Scales and teeth preserved in one slab
evidenceSummary: CT and histology document several systems in UMZC 2000.32. The fossil's compressed, incomplete outline and a matrix-dependent placement keep these findings specific to one specimen and analysis.

title.en: One compressed fossil preserves many systems
title.zh: 一件受压化石保存的多套解剖系统

text.en: UMZC 2000.32, from the Upper Givetian Lower Plattenkalk at Unterthal near Bergisch Gladbach, is the single specimen in this account. CT imaging and histology reveal parts of the neurocranium, jaws, gill skeleton and pectoral girdle, along with cartilage, scales and teeth. The combination makes the slab informative, but it remains one dorsoventrally compressed individual with its tail missing.
text.zh: 来自上吉维特阶 Lower Plattenkalk、Unterthal（贝吉施格拉德巴赫）附近的 UMZC 2000.32，是本档案唯一标本。CT 成像与组织学揭示脑颅、颌、鳃骨架和胸带的部分结构，也显示软骨、鳞片与牙齿。这种组合让石板化石具有研究价值，但它仍是一件背腹压扁、尾部缺失的个体。

title.en: What the fossil can and cannot establish
title.zh: 这件化石能说明什么？

text.en: The cited phylogenetic analysis places Gladbachus on the chondrichthyan stem, outside the crown group of living sharks and rays; that result depends on the character matrix. The fossil does not directly reveal diet, habitat preference or swimming performance, and the missing tail prevents a complete body reconstruction. Its roughly 385-million-year-old occurrence is a record for this specimen and locality, not a global first appearance for chondrichthyans.
text.zh: 所引系统发育分析将格拉德巴赫鱼置于软骨鱼干群、现生鲨和鳐的冠群之外；这一结果取决于所用性状矩阵。化石没有直接记录食性、栖息地偏好或游泳性能，尾部缺失也无法完整复原全身。约 3.85 亿年前的年代是这件标本及其地点的记录，不是软骨鱼类的全球首现。

title.en: Coates et al. (2018), Gladbachus specimen anatomy and phylogenetic analysis
title.zh: Coates 等（2018），格拉德巴赫鱼标本解剖与系统发育分析

scope.en: The single specimen UMZC 2000.32, its CT and histological description, Figures 1–4 and Supplementary Figure S1. The study supports the anatomical observations and reports a matrix-based chondrichthyan-stem placement; it does not provide a complete outline, direct ecology or a global first appearance.
scope.zh: 唯一标本 UMZC 2000.32、CT 与组织学描述、图 1–4 及补充图 S1。该研究支持解剖观察并报告基于矩阵的软骨鱼干群位置；它没有提供完整体形、直接生态记录或全球首现。

overviewZh: 唯一已知标本 UMZC 2000.32 在一块压扁的岩板上保存了多个头骨和身体系统。其混合解剖特征支持所引分析将其置于软骨鱼干群；但尾部缺失且样本仅含一个个体，限制了更广泛的结论。
evidenceSummaryZh: CT 扫描和组织学记录了 UMZC 2000.32 的若干器官系统。化石轮廓受压且不完整，其系统位置又取决于所用矩阵，因此这些发现仅适用于这一件标本和这项分析。

commonNameZh: 宽吻泥盆纪对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼
overview: Several partly articulated Famennian skeletons preserve body proportions, and specimens AA.MEM.DS.12 and PIMUZ A/I 5159 retain three-dimensional neurocrania with a broad rostrum and widely spaced nasal capsules. PIMUZ A/I 5155 contains one small actinopterygian as stomach content.

ecology.diet: One specimen records a more or less articulated actinopterygian about 40 mm long in the stomach. It documents a feeding event, not the species’ full diet.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the marine Famennian Thylacocephalan Layer; preferred habitat in life is unresolved.
ecology.locomotion: A high-aspect-ratio tail and large pectoral fins are preserved, but swimming performance was not measured.
ecology.bodySize: Proportions of the studied specimens yield estimated in-life lengths of 0.8–2.5 m; this is a specimen-based range, not a complete genus-wide envelope.
ecology.dietZh: 一件标本的胃内保存了一条长约 40 毫米、近乎关节连接的辐鳍鱼。这记录了一次取食事件，并不代表该种的完整食谱。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自法门期海相 Thylacocephalan 层；其生前偏好的栖地尚不明确。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了高纵横比的尾部和大型胸鳍，但没有测定游泳表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 根据所研究标本的比例，推算其生前体长约为 0.8–2.5 米；这是标本范围估计，不是全属完整体型范围。

traits: The snout is broad and enclosed in cartilage.
The large nasal capsules are widely separated.
The tail is high-aspect-ratio and lunate.
evidenceSummary: Specimens document articulated bodies and cranial anatomy. Published character matrices place the genus among early symmoriiforms, while alternative stem-holocephalan and stem-elasmobranch placements remain in discussion.
overviewZh: 数件法门期部分关节连接的骨架保存了身体比例；AA.MEM.DS.12 和 PIMUZ A/I 5159 还保存了三维脑颅，其吻部宽阔，鼻囊间距较大。PIMUZ A/I 5155 的胃内容物中有一条小型辐鳍鱼。
traitsZh: 吻部宽阔，外有软骨包围。
大型鼻囊彼此间隔较远。
尾部呈高纵横比的镰形。
evidenceSummaryZh: 标本直接显示了关节连接的身体和颅部解剖。已发表的特征矩阵将其置于早期对称软骨鱼类之中，但其究竟更接近全头类干群还是板鳃类干群，仍有不同解释.

commonNameZh: 具鳃盖的密西西比世对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼
overview: Cosmoselachus mehlingi is known from the partial holotype AMNH FF 20509. CT reconstruction reveals an unusual gill-cover structure formed by elongated, fused branchial rays, alongside jaws, teeth and partial fins.

ecology.diet: Undetermined; tooth arrangement is preserved but prey use is not observed
ecology.habitat: Fayetteville Shale marine depositional setting; life-habitat preference unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Partial pectoral fins are preserved; locomotor performance was not measured

traits: Elongate fused pharyngeal-arch rays forming an operculum
Small cladodont teeth in widely spaced families
Fifteen to eighteen distal fin radials
evidenceSummary: The CT reconstruction and phylogenetic analysis support a falcatid symmoriiform interpretation, but the anatomy comes from one damaged partial specimen.

title.en: A gill-cover structure reconstructed from CT
title.zh: 由 CT 重建的鳃区覆盖结构

text.en: AMNH FF 20509 preserves jaws, part of the skull base, gill supports, pectoral cartilage, fins and teeth. CT imaging shows elongated, fused branchial rays forming an operculum over the gill region.
text.zh: AMNH FF 20509 保存了颌部、部分颅底、鳃支撑结构、胸鳍软骨、鳍与牙齿。CT 成像显示，细长且融合的鳃条形成了覆盖鳃区的结构。

title.en: A shark relative known from one partial fossil
title.zh: 仅由一件不完整化石认识的鲨类近亲

text.en: A phylogenetic analysis supports placing the fossil among falcatid symmoriiforms. The sample does not reveal prey or measured swimming performance, and its damaged state limits what can be said about the whole animal.
text.zh: 系统发育分析支持将该化石置于镰鲛类对称鳍鲨目中。现有材料没有记录猎物或实测游泳性能；化石残缺也限制了对完整个体的判断。

overview: What can isolated teeth tell us about an animal whose complete body is missing? Qianodus tooth whorls, Fanjingshania dermal elements and the single Gladbachus specimen preserve different parts of early chondrichthyan anatomy. Comparing them requires keeping each sample and its preservation separate.
overviewZh: 没有完整身体，孤立的牙齿能告诉我们什么？Qianodus 的齿旋、Fanjingshania 的皮骨材料和单件 Gladbachus 标本，各自保存了早期软骨鱼解剖的不同部分。比较它们时，需要保留各份材料的样本边界与保存条件。
evidenceSummary: The name cartilaginous fishes can hide the hard parts in their fossil record. Chondrichthyan material includes mineralized teeth and scale denticles, as well as fin spines, dermal plates and calcified cartilage. Each fossil records only the tissues and body regions actually preserved.
evidenceSummaryZh: “软骨鱼类”这个名称容易让人忽略化石记录中的硬组织。软骨鱼材料也包括矿化牙齿与鳞片齿突，以及鳍棘、皮骨板和钙化软骨。每件化石只能说明它实际保存下来的组织与身体部位。

title.en: The Chondrichthyes skeleton is not all cartilage
title.zh: 软骨鱼类的骨骼并非全是软骨

text.en: The name cartilaginous fishes can hide the hard parts in their fossil record. Chondrichthyan material includes mineralized teeth and scale denticles, as well as fin spines, dermal plates and calcified cartilage. Each fossil records only the tissues and body regions actually preserved.
text.zh: “软骨鱼类”这个名称容易让人忽略化石记录中的硬组织。软骨鱼材料也包括矿化牙齿与鳞片齿突，以及鳍棘、皮骨板和钙化软骨。每件化石只能说明它实际保存下来的组织与身体部位。

title.en: Qianodus tooth whorls preserve a feeding structure
title.zh: Qianodus 牙旋记录齿列结构

text.en: At about 439 Ma, Qianodus duplicis is represented by 23 isolated tooth whorls, catalogued as IVPP V26641–V26663. The whorls preserve paired rows of non-shedding teeth added from the tongue side in an offset pattern. They record early jawed-vertebrate dentition, but no associated jaw or body is known from these specimens. The Atlas uses the sample as an early stem-line evidence anchor, not as a crown-group first appearance or a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 约 439 Ma 的 Qianodus duplicis 由 23 个孤立牙旋代表，馆藏编号为 IVPP V26641–V26663。牙旋保存了成对排列、不会脱落的牙齿；新牙从舌侧以错列方式添加。这些标本记录了早期有颌脊椎动物的齿列，但没有已知的关联颌骨或身体材料。图谱将其作为早期干群证据锚点，而非冠群首现或直系祖先。

title.en: Fanjingshania preserves spines, plates and scales
title.zh: Fanjingshania 保存鳍棘、骨板与鳞片

text.en:
The *Fanjingshania renovata* material comes from the Shiqian–Tunping section at Leijiatun, Guizhou, in the Rongxi Formation's *Ozarkodina guizhouensis* conodont biozone. The authors assign the horizon to the upper Aeronian, about 439 Ma, within the *O. parahassi* division of that biozone; they discuss lower Telychian estimates as an alternative linked to diachrony in the formation. The sample consists of separate dermal plates, scales and fin spines, including pectoral, pelvic, dorsal, anal and prepelvic spines, not one articulated skeleton.

Histology distinguishes these structures: fin-spine sections show calcified cartilage and cellular bone, while scale odontodes show resorption and replacement. The study reports no odontogenic tissue in the spines. A fin spine, a scale crown and a tooth whorl therefore document different structures, even when all are mineralized.
text.zh:
*Fanjingshania renovata* 材料采自贵州 Leijiatun 的 Shiqian–Tunping 剖面，地层属于溶溪组 *Ozarkodina guizhouensis* 牙形类生物带。作者将层位定为晚埃隆阶，约 439 Ma，位于该生物带的 *O. parahassi* 分段内；论文也讨论了与地层穿时性有关的早特列奇阶替代年代意见。样本由分散的皮骨板、鳞片和鳍棘组成，包括胸鳍、腹鳍、背鳍、臀鳍和前腹鳍棘，并非一具关节相连的完整骨架。

组织学显示这些结构各不相同：鳍棘切片可见钙化软骨和细胞骨，鳞片齿突则显示吸收与替换。研究报告鳍棘中没有成齿组织。因此，鳍棘、鳞片冠和牙旋记录的是不同结构，即使它们都发生了矿化。

title.en: Gladbachus complicates the familiar shark body plan
title.zh: Gladbachus 使熟悉的鲨鱼体制变得复杂

text.en:
The single known Gladbachus adentatus specimen, UMZC 2000.32, comes from the Givetian Lower Plattenkalk of Germany, about 385 Ma. CT imaging and histology reveal parts of the skull, jaws, gill skeleton, pectoral girdle, cartilage, scales and teeth. Its combination of characters differs from a simple modern-shark template, and the study places it on the chondrichthyan stem.

The authors infer that it may have suspension-fed from its skeletal anatomy; that is a functional hypothesis, not an observed meal. Together, these separated Silurian and Devonian samples raise a broader question: which parts of the later shark-like body plan were inherited, and which appeared independently during early chondrichthyan evolution? They do not establish a continuous fossil range or a direct line of ancestry.
text.zh:
目前已知唯一的 Gladbachus adentatus 标本 UMZC 2000.32 来自德国吉维特期下普拉特恩石灰岩，约 385 Ma。CT 成像与组织学揭示了部分头骨、颌、鳃骨骼、胸带、软骨、鳞片和牙齿。它的性状组合不同于简单的现代鲨鱼模板；研究将其置于软骨鱼干群。

作者根据其骨骼形态推测它可能采用悬浮摄食；这是功能解释，并非直接观察到的进食行为。志留纪与泥盆纪这些相隔的样本提出了更广泛的问题：后来鲨鱼样体制的哪些部分是继承而来，哪些可能在早期软骨鱼演化中独立出现？这些样本不能建立连续的化石范围或直系祖先关系。

title.zh: An early chondrichthyan and the evolutionary assembly of a shark body plan

scope.zh: 对德国吉维特期 Lower Plattenkalk 的单件 Gladbachus adentatus 标本 UMZC 2000.32 进行 CT 和组织学重新描述。
